content: We use two MP iterations ($T$=2) for the basic MPAD, and two MP iterations at each level, for the hierarchical variants. We set $d$ to 64, except on IMDB and Yelp on which $d=128$, and use a two-layer MLP. The final graph representations are passed through a softmax for classification. We train MPAD in an end-to-end fashion by minimizing the cross-entropy loss function with the Adam optimizer BIBREF48 and an initial learning rate of 0.001.
